t: This is the Young Vic, a performing-arts theatre on The Cut, near the South Bank, in the London Borough of Lambeth. It was created by the director Frank Dunlop, who founded both the theatre and its company. His idea was a theatre featuring young actors that would reach a youthful audience. Dunlop was its artistic and administrative director from 1968 through 1971, and he went on to direct plays for the company throughout the 1970s.
